description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Tata Consultancy Services is hiring an Entry-Level Forward Deployed Engineer to help build, deploy, and improve AI-powered applications in enterprise environments. The role supports taking AI solutions from prototype to production through customer collaboration, integrations, AI workflows, data pipelines, and system evaluation.
Forward Deployed Engineer supporting AI solution deployment, enterprise integrations, agentic workflows, data pipelines, and system evaluation

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with customer teams and internal stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver AI solutions
• Support the development and deployment of AI-powered applications
• Build integrations between AI services and enterprise systems, APIs, and data platforms
• Assist with agentic AI workflows, multi-agent systems, and orchestration frameworks
• Develop data pipelines and gain exposure to vector databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
• Help create evaluation and observability frameworks to monitor AI system performance
• Troubleshoot integration and reliability issues with guidance from senior engineers
• Follow engineering best practices for coding, testing, and deployment

Requirements:
• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field
• 0 to 3 years of professional experience
• Strong foundation in Python development and AI/ML fundamentals, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI
• Understanding of APIs, databases, data structures, and software design principles
• Experience using AI-assisted coding tools
• Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
• Minimum GPA of 3.0 or above
• Graduated between September 2024 and December 2026
• Candidates must not require sponsorship now or in the future for employment

Preferred:
• Experience with Java, Go, JavaScript/Node.js, or other full-stack technologies
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Exposure to vector databases, RAG pipelines, agentic AI systems, or multi-agent architectures
